<!--
Thanks for contributing to Orientim. Keep the description short and concrete.
-->

**What this changes**
One or two sentences on the behaviour before and after.

**Why**
The problem it solves, or the issue it closes (`Closes #123`).

**Checklist**

- [ ] `pytest tests/` passes locally.
- [ ] `orientim conformance` still reports no undeclared failures.
- [ ] New behaviour has a test that can actually fail — a test that cannot fail
      is worse than no test (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- [ ] User-facing strings are in English; docs updated if behaviour changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if this is user-visible.
